fixtures.name: Areca Palm
fixtures.flavor: Thin fronds and a clay pot. The cheapest way to stop a corner looking like a corridor.

fixtures.name: Fiddle-Leaf Fig
fixtures.flavor: Broad leaves on a bare stem, in a cream vase. It fills the window wall the way a lamp fills a table.

fixtures.name: Trailing Pothos
fixtures.flavor: It grows down instead of up, off three brass legs. The only plant in here that reaches for the floor.

fixtures.name: Snake Plant
fixtures.flavor: Stiff blades in a plain pot. Survives a bar, which is more than most things manage.

fixtures.name: Agave Bowl
fixtures.flavor: Blue-green and low and wide, in a shallow dish. It sits under the neon rather than in front of it.

fixtures.name: Counter Candle
fixtures.flavor: One small flame at the quiet end of the bar.

fixtures.name: Brass Sconce
fixtures.flavor: Warm brass, warmer light.

fixtures.name: Hanging Lantern
fixtures.flavor: Fills the gap the ceiling lamps leave.

fixtures.name: Paper Lantern
fixtures.flavor: A soft red glow for the far corner.

fixtures.name: Neon Martini
fixtures.flavor: The classic sign: a glass that never empties.

fixtures.name: Rustic Bar Table
fixtures.flavor: Reclaimed oak and a welded frame. It wobbles, and nobody minds.

fixtures.name: Brass Pedestal Table
fixtures.flavor: Green leather, a brass stem. The seat people ask for by name.

fixtures.name: Steel Gaslift Set
fixtures.flavor: Plum vinyl on a polished column. Spins if you let it.

fixtures.name: Single Draught Tower
fixtures.flavor: One line, one lager. A start.

fixtures.name: Arched Draught Bridge
fixtures.flavor: A brass bridge on two legs, handles in a row across it.

fixtures.name: Triple Draught Tower
fixtures.flavor: One column, three spouts, and nothing waiting its turn.

fixtures.name: Glass Tube Lamps
fixtures.flavor: Cyan at the cap, pink down the tube, a steel bracket holding it. The cheapest thing in the room that knows what year it is.

fixtures.name: Sunset Panels
fixtures.flavor: A cream face in a coral frame, wide as a window. It washes the wall instead of dotting it.

fixtures.name: Palm Lamps
fixtures.flavor: A brass palm with a lit coconut. Nobody needs it. Everybody wants it.

fixtures.name: Flamingo Triptych
fixtures.flavor: The coast in three frames. The flamingo stays past closing.

fixtures.name: Steel Sink
fixtures.flavor: Cold water and a place to put the night's glasses.

fixtures.name: Brass Sink
fixtures.flavor: The same cold water, in a basin that catches the neon and keeps it.

fixtures.name: Tide Rug
fixtures.flavor: Orange running through teal, a shoreline read from the air. It takes the echo off the boards.

fixtures.name: Drip Mat
fixtures.flavor: Black rubber under the font. It catches what the glass does not.
